property_summary: Scheduling an operation with delay < minDelay must revert and therefore not mark the operation as pending; scheduling with delay >= minDelay succeeds and makes isOperation return true.
If execute(...) succeeds then the corresponding operation id becomes done (isOperationDone == true) and was previously ready (isOperationReady == true).

Executing an operation that succeeds must emit that the operation becomes done and the call to the target succeeded (i.e., execute only succeeds when the operation is ready and afterwards isOperationDone is true).
If execute(...) returns (does not revert) then the operation id was ready before the call and is done afterwards.
If execute(...) does not revert then the operation id was ready immediately before the call (isOperationReady == true).
